explanation: The article the earlier record cites says it in its § Consequences: "The heightened tensions of the Marco Polo Bridge incident led directly to full-scale war between the Empire of Japan and the Republic of China, with the Battle of Beiping-Tianjin at the end of July and the Battle of Shanghai in August." The article names the battle as one of two engagements the incident led directly to, five weeks after it. The type is `caused`, because "led directly to" states a mechanism. The confidence is `probable`, because the encyclopaedia article is the only source the atlas can open here (rule 22).
